PROJECTS

AutoStacc is the platform behind this store. Projects create; AutoStacc sells, delivers and organizes what they make.

Projects

    How AutoStacc works

    1. A project creates music, samples, presets, stems and visuals.
    2. AutoStacc catalogs and sells it, with checkout on Stripe.
    3. It lands in Your Stacc, sorted by project, Stacclet, Pac and content type.
    4. Auto handles the rest: follow a project and switch on Auto-Stacc to add its free releases automatically.
    Your Stacc
    Your library: everything you've collected.
    Stacclet
    A collection of related Pacs from one project.
    Pac
    A folder of content: MIDI, samples, loops, presets and more. Download one file, a selection or the lot.
    Auto-Stacc
    Automatically add a followed project's eligible free content. Paid releases show up as new, never as owned.
